_comment: Every non-Indonesian word this film prints on screen, with its ONE correct spelling and the variants that must never appear. tools/spellcheck_plan.py reads this before any generation is spent. Add a word here the first time it is used; the planner is not allowed to invent a spelling and let the model draw it.

words.note: The 'h' is an ASR artefact: the voice says 'cai' and the transcript wrote 'cahi' or 'chai'. m20's card names still read kartu_cahi though the printed text is correct.

words.meaning: awalan nama tempat Sunda, dari 'cai' (air) — Ci Citarum, Ci Bodas
words.note: 'chi' is not an Indonesian or Sundanese word at all — it is the romanisation of a Chinese syllable. m02 printed CHI on a slip on the same page that printed 'BERAWALAN CI' correctly. 'tji' is the pre-1972 Dutch orthography. NOTE: 'chai' belongs to 'cai' (water), not here — the ASR wrote both 'chai' and 'cahi' for spoken 'cai'.
